Dragons 1.2.7 - wild dragons on hills and slopes

Wild dragons
- Wild dragons now also spawn on slopes and uneven ground. Before, the ground under a dragon had to be nearly flat, so in mountains, taiga and badlands about one in four spawns failed.
- In forests and jungles dragons now prefer a clearing on the ground. They sit on the treetops only when there is no room below, so they are easier to spot.

Tip: only one wild dragon lives in each area of about 100 blocks. If you want more of them, raise spawnChance or lower spawnSpacing in config/skywyrms.json.

Thanks for the reports!
